title: B3LYP-to-MP2 transferable primitive-Hessian correction
summary: Fit a compact a-priori correction from analytic B3LYP/6-31+G* Hessians to analytic MP2/def2-TZVP harmonic Hessians on disjoint whole-molecule splits.
gates: identical molecule split and atom order at both levels
analytic harmonic Hessians at separately optimized minima
hydrogen-role term retained only if validation RMS decreases
coordinate_policy: Transform B3LYP and MP2 Hessians on the identical complete frozen SMITH primitive pool and compare assigned harmonic modes after proper rigid alignment.
backend_policy: The fitted model consumes only the two certified analytic Hessian corpora; it does not launch a quantum backend.
